story.title: Ledger migration to event sourcing
story.situation: Reconciliation errors in our ledger caused weekly manual fixes by finance.
story.task: Lead a 4-person team to redesign the ledger without downtime.
story.action: Designed an append-only event model, ran dual writes with shadow reads for 6 weeks, and migrated accounts in batches.
story.result: Reconciliation errors fell 92% and finance stopped weekly manual fixes.

interviews.practice_question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a technical decision.
interviews.practice_answer: At Ledgerly my manager wanted to add a cache in front of the ledger. I worried about stale balances, so I wrote a short doc comparing a cache with read replicas, ran a load test, and we went with replicas plus a cache only for non-critical reads. p99 dropped from 840 to 120 ms with no stale-balance incidents.
